reviews.title: Extremely disappointing update…
reviews.text:
Getting rid of the Bond Community completely took away one of the biggest reasons I used Lovense. It gave people an actual place to meet, post, interact, and connect with new people, whether they owned a Lovense toy or not.

What makes this even more disappointing is that Lovense promotes the idea of meeting and connecting with new people, yet removed the main feature that actually allowed people to do that. It completely contradicts what made the app and community appealing in the first place.

Trying to replace Bond Community with Reddit doesn’t come close to the same experience. There’s barely any actual interaction — it’s basically just patterns, likes, and downloads. You can’t even comment or genuinely socialize with people.

I’ve purchased multiple Lovense toys because I loved the toys AND the community surrounding them. Removing Bond Community makes the app feel pointless for meeting and connecting with new people, which was a huge part of the experience for me.

Please bring back Bond Community and restore the social features that actually allowed users to meet and interact with each other. Until there is a real in-app community again, I’ll be purchasing from another company instead. I haven’t used the app or any of my Lovense toys since Bond Community was removed.
